title: Treatise on the Binding Cast
summary: Teaches how to cast the bolas so the cords knot about the legs, and how qi tightens the bind.

title: A Handbook of the Weighted Cord Guard
summary: Teaches a thrower to defend with whirling weights and cord, and to close the guard on a foe who steps in.

title: Manual of the Three-Weight Entanglement
summary: Sets out the three-weight tangle from knee to hip, and the qi-backed drag that keeps a snared foe hunched.

title: Mounted Catcher's Compendium
summary: Trains a rider to whirl, cast and haul the bolas from the saddle at a running quarry.

title: The Hunter's Book of the Running Throw
summary: A hunter's guide to stalking, reading game sign and snaring fast quarry by the legs over rough ground.

title: Drill-Book of the Cord and the Counter
summary: Drills the use of cord and weight against an armed opponent, binding the blade before striking back.

title: Canon of the Weighted Reach
summary: Teaches long-cord casting, distance counting and recovery for throwers who strike at the far end of their reach.

title: Short Treatise on Cord Control Underfoot
summary: Shows how to pin, hook and lift the cord with the feet in a close fight against a larger opponent.
